⚠️ Quick Update on the App
Due to some backend limitations we discovered during testing, we’ve decided to pause the big launch for now.
Right now the app will stay limited to the 50 students who already joined as beta testers. Surprisingly, this small group already pushed the server close to its limits 😅 so we want to stabilize everything before opening it to everyone.
Over the next few weeks we’ll be:
🔧 Improving the backend
🐛 Fixing bugs and issues you reported
✨ Upgrading the app experience
🚀 Goal: Relaunch in April with a system ready for up to 5,000 students.
Thanks to everyone testing and giving feedback — you’re helping build something really cool for campus 🙌
